server.title: Document Integrity Validator
server.description: AI reasoning checks any document against known international standards before your agent acts on it.

serverInfo.name: document-integrity-validator-mcp
serverInfo.description: Every trade finance and agentic procurement workflow has a moment where the agent must act on a received document before it can proceed. This server answers that question in one call -- returning a machine-readable PASS / FLAG / FAIL verdict against named international document standards. Used before any payment, fund release, or document submission.
